items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: there was a man named George Freeman that was producing shows... he said, now, I'm going to have to change your billing... So George Freeman was the one that gave us that.

ctx.x: And this is where we got the Mac and Mac from. We were at Bailey's and their builders is Mac Bride and Mac Bride, you know. But there was a man named George Freeman that was producing shows over on Peter Street in Atlanta. At a theater called the Paradise Theater. And when we went over there to work, he said, now, I'm going to have to change your billing. See, I tried to get that Mac Bride and Mac Bride, but that's too long. See, why not just call yourself Mac and Mac? Well, that's where it started. So George…
